Based on the image provided, here is a detailed list of every visual element and their positions, followed by the specific analysis of the input boxes.

### **Visual Elements List**

**Top Header Bar:**
*   **Logo & Title:** "GPX Repair Studio" (top left).
*   **Status/Mode Label:** "Local-first" (next to title).
*   **File Name:** "demo-qc-run-with-gaps.gpx" (centered in header).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   "Share card" (top right).
    *   "Map & tools" (top right).
    *   "Statistics" (top right).
    *   "New file" (far top right).

**Main Map Area (Background):**
*   **Tool Toggle:** "Drawing" button with a pencil icon and shortcut key "[D]" (top left of map).
*   **Map Info Box:**
    *   Distance: "0 m".
    *   Status Tag: Orange tag labeled "**Estimated**".
    *   Point Count: "0/128 pts".
    *   Subtext: "(road length, not straight line)".
*   **Map Content:** OpenStreetMap view showing roads (Visayas Ave, Mindanao Ave), location names (Quezon City, Bago Bantay), and a black GPS track line with circular nodes.
*   **Footer:** Copyright text "© OpenStreetMap contributors | OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles Data from OpenStreetMap" and an info icon.

**Right Sidebar Panel:**
*   **Section Title:** "Between clicks, follow".
*   **Toggle Group (Radio Buttons):**
    *   "**Roads**" (Selected/Filled black).
    *   "Footpaths".
    *   "Straight lines".
*   **Instructional Text:** Paragraphs explaining how clicking works, dragging points, and public routing services.
*   **Sub-section Title:** "Timestamps for this repair".
*   **Instructional Text:** Explanation of gaps and timestamps.
*   **Button:** "**Add a duration**" (Orange/Brown background).
*   **Legend Box:**
    *   Line icon + "gap duration".
    *   Black square + "**Recorded**".
    *   Dashed line icon + "estimated pace".
    *   Orange square + "**Estimated**".
*   **Instructional Text:** Text about entering duration to estimate test.
*   **Dropdown/Label:** "Elevation" followed by a button/tag "**Not estimated**".
*   **Instructional Text:** Text about drawing missing route first.

**Modal Dialog (Center Overlay):**
*   **Title:** "**How long was the missing stretch?**"
*   **Close Icon:** "X" button (top right of dialog).
*   **Description Text:** "The repair’s interior timestamps will span exactly this duration — recorded timestamps are never changed."
*   **Input Labels:**
    *   "**Hours**"
    *   "**Minutes**"
    *   "**Seconds**"
*   **Input Boxes:** (See detailed analysis below).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   "**Cancel**" (White background, grey border).
    *   "**Save duration**" (Orange background, white text).

---

### **Input Box Analysis**

**1. Quantity Confirmation:**
Yes, there are **exactly 3 input boxes** located inside the center modal dialog.

**2. Relative Positions:**
The three input boxes are arranged in a single horizontal row.
*   The **Hours** input box is on the **left**.
*   The **Minutes** input box is in the **middle**.
*   The **Seconds** input box is on the **right**.

**3. Exact Appearance Description:**
*   **Shape & Size:** They are rectangular with rounded corners.
*   **Borders:**
    *   The **Hours** and **Minutes** boxes have a prominent, thick **orange border** (indicating they are active, focused, or required).
    *   The **Seconds** box has a thin, subtle **grey border**.
*   **Content:**
    *   All three boxes contain the number "**0**".
    *   The **Minutes** box features small up/down arrow buttons (spinners) on its right inner edge for incrementing/decrementing the value.
